categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies coin locking logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes an issue where upgrading a coin lock from non-persistent to persistent fails to update in-memory state, leaving a stale database lock record after the coin is spent and the wallet is reloaded (#36304). This addresses a state inconsistency in wallet coin locking, though it is an edge case that does not risk loss of funds or critical wallet corruption.
